# Herdr Vendor Patches

This ledger documents every downstream patch carried under `vendor/` in `herdr-app`.

## Replay Discipline

Every updated vendored crate follows a replayable patch stack:

1. One pristine import commit matching the exact crates.io tarball:
   `chore(vendor): import <crate> <version>`
2. One commit per carried patch, keeping a `HERDR:` marker in code:
   `fix(vendor): <what it does>`
3. Dropped patches have no commit and are recorded under **Dropped / Moved Patches** with proof.

To upgrade a crate later, import the new pristine tarball and replay only the `fix(vendor):` commits for that crate, dropping any patch proven upstream.

## Stage 2c Joined-Build Verification Checklist

Run these once Stage 2a (GPUI `0.3.14`) and Stage 2b (`gpui-base`) are joined:

1. **Terminal cell metrics (G9, A3, W5, Win5)**: `cargo test` for `src/terminal.rs` (`ligatures_change_glyphs_without_moving_terminal_cells`, `ghostty_cells_and_clusters_at_fractional_scales`, `glyph_x_recentres_glyphs_as_ghostty`, `cell_text_paints_glyph_x_across_from_its_cell`) on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
2. **Frame capture (G1, A1, L2, M3, W1, Win2)**: `cargo test --test shot_pixels` + `herdr-app shot` (including occluded macOS window, Linux Wayland & X11, Windows VM).
3. **macOS idle display link (M2)**: Instruments/`powermetrics` idle wakeup measurement on real macOS 14+ (and macOS 13 if supported) with a static terminal and a 10 fps spinner.
4. **Dead keys on Linux & Windows (L3, Win1)**: `cargo test -p gpui-pre-windows` (`dead_key_completion_uses_native_text_across_windows`, `native_text_dispatch_does_not_mark_replayed_prefixes`), `src/terminal.rs::replayed_shortcut_prefixes_keep_terminal_encoding`, plus live US-Intl dead-key typing on Wayland, X11 (normal + Kitty mode), and Windows VM.
5. **XIM on Linux X11 (L6, X1, X2, XC1)**: `cargo test -p xim-ctext`, `cargo test -p zed-xim --lib --features x11rb-client`, `XIM_TEST_DISPLAY=:99 cargo test -p zed-xim --features x11rb-client -- --ignored`, plus manual `fcitx4`/`ibus` focus-cycle CJK test on X11.
6. **Windows plain quads & DirectWrite (Win4, Win7)**: `cargo test -p gpui-pre-windows` (`missing_characters_have_no_glyph`, `plain_quad_tests`), WARP `#423` frame-time benchmark (test dropping Win7), and visual check of translucent overlays/borders/paths under `0.3.14` D3D11 depth testing.
7. **Wayland maximize/snap & multi-seat & WSLg clipboard (L1, L5, L7, L8)**: maximize -> half-screen snap on Wayland; secondary `wl_seat` test; `readelf -d` check for absence of `libxkbcommon-x11.so.0`; WSLg middle-click paste.
8. **Dark portal first frame (L4)**: `cargo test -p gpui-pre-linux --lib startup_tests` + launch on dark GNOME/KDE desktop confirming no light flash.
9. **COLRv1 emoji & swash empty bitmap guard (G10, W3, W4)**: `cargo test --test colrv1` on Linux.
10. **Live SVG/image reload, FileDrop, focus yield, mouse observers (G3, G4, G5, G6, G7, A2, W2, Win3)**: `src/window.rs` image/SVG/blur tests + `src/mods/lifecycle_tests.rs` drag/file-drop tests + `src/mods/render_tests.rs` animation test.
11. **macOS keyboard/IME, Prohibited activation, & Liquid Glass blur (G2, G8, M4, M5, M7)**: `cargo test -p gpui-pre-macos` (8 `events::tests`), `src/keys.rs` & `src/terminal.rs` Option-as-Alt tests, `herdr-app check` Dock test, Vietnamese Telex / `Fn+Esc` / Caps Lock manual test, and blurred layout test on macOS 26+ (comparing with and without M7).
